Indexes a folder of las files, so that the lidar modules read only the points of the area they work on.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, lidar<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.gears.io.las.index.LasIndexer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFolder` | folder |  |  | The folder containing the las files to index. |
| `pIndexname` | String |  | `index.lasfolder` | The name for the main index file, written in the folder: the extension .lasfolder is added if missing. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The optional code defining the target coordinate reference system. This is needed only if the file has no prj file. If set, it will be used over the prj file. |
| `pCellsize` | double |  | `5.0` | The size of the cells into which to split the las file for indexing (in units defined by the projection). |
| `doOverview` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, also writes a shapefile of the outlines of the files, as the convex hulls of their points, named as the main index. |
| `pThreads` | int |  | `1` | The number of files indexed at the same time. |
